## [v0.2.0] - 2026-09-25

### Added

- Added opt-in Phrasplit sentence splitting while preserving model-limit chunks in no-split mode
- Added opt-in static voice-level calibration from bundle metadata or an explicit gain override

### Changed

- **BREAKING:** Changed the PocketSynth engine boundary to use PocketRuntime for already-prepared speakable text
- **BREAKING:** Changed PocketRuntime.synthesize() to a strict single-request API with one encoding and at most one inference

### Removed

- **BREAKING:** Removed planner, document-streaming, composition, and compatibility APIs, along with their runtime package dependencies

<!-- generated by releaseledger -->

## [v0.1.0] - 2026-09-23

### Added

- Added the UtterPlan-driven synthesis pipeline for local and managed Pocket ONNX bundles
- Added convenience APIs for managed synthesis and atomic WAV file output
- Added managed asset progress reporting, runtime checks, and documented first-WAV workflows
- Added managed and local quickstart scripts and expanded CLI synthesis controls
- Added bundle-declared predefined voice selection to the pipeline, convenience API, and CLI

### Changed

- Changed minimum supported OnnxVoice and UtterPlan versions to the APIs required for Pocket support
- Improved setup guidance for gated predefined voices and error reporting for access and dependency failures

### Fixed

- Fixed planning with omitted UtterPlan settings under the current API
